title: Orchestration Hardening: Active Coexistence & Metabolic Heat
description: Redefining swarm safety from 'Ghost Detection' to 'Metabolic Heat' verification to manage multi-agent coexistence.

principles.name: Metabolic Heat Verification
principles.description: An agent process is only considered 'Active' if it is generating metabolic heat—defined as recent writes to its primary chat log or Heartwood artifacts.
principles.threshold: 600 seconds (10 minutes) of log silence triggers a 'Cold Session' warning.

principles.name: Sovereign Coexistence
principles.description: The metarepo must support multiple concurrent agent sessions. Collisions are managed through forensic log tailing rather than binary PID exclusion.
principles.mandate: Never assume a session is a ghost; always verify the tail.

system_updates.update: Implemented a 'Metabolic Heat Check'. The script now tails the session's log path (discovered via dynamic/static/) to determine if the peer is actively responding or stalled.
system_updates.result: Prevents accidental takeovers of high-velocity peers like Keraunos while allowing recovery from 'Cold' OOM/FATAL failures.
